review_input.original_instruction: You're currently staring at a brown-framed painting in a dining room. Turn a hundred-and-eighty degrees and take two steps forward, until you're right in front of the open brown double doors. Once you're at the entrance to this art gallery room, enter the first door to your right, slightly passing the silver bath tub to your left. In this new room, you see a silver staircase, take one step forward to the base of the silver staircase. Now, you see the silver staircase going up to the left, or up to the right. Go up the silver staircase towards the left, and once you're halfway up the staircase, and staring directly in front of a white wall. To your right, you see the end of the white railing, you're done.
